api.command: make api-coverage PYTHON=.venv/bin/python (pytest --cov-fail-under=75 plus exact statement-ratio summary)

installation: uv pip sync --python .venv/bin/python --require-hashes --offline requirements/test.lock; npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

critique_fixes.ci_envelopes: Unit and frontend artifacts upload only .runtime/ci; worker and web QA summaries use separate artifacts. Release downloads still target .runtime/ci.
critique_fixes.python_installs: Fast, unit, contract and security CI jobs install the complete hashed requirements/test.lock with --only-binary=:all:.
critique_fixes.named_targets: api16-full replaces the uninstrumented worker and API suites with their coverage targets; web-validate includes web-coverage once. Existing CI lanes invoke coverage targets directly. The API summary gate compares integer covered/total counts without rounding.
critique_fixes.api_gate_tests: api-coverage runs the summarizer unit suite before the instrumented API suite; tests cover 75%, 74.9%, production path scope, and report-total consistency.
critique_fixes.api_summary_artifact: The contract workflow uploads the location-free .runtime/qa/api-summary.json when available.
critique_fixes.static_checks: YAML/Make/lock checks passed for artifact roots, release paths, hashed installs, coverage dependencies and all 45 runtime/52 test lock entries. In-memory mutations of combined upload roots, unhashed pytest install, omitted API/Web floor, and a package with no hashes were rejected. make -n confirmed each named suite runs once.

exclusions.api: The denominator includes measured statements in apps/api/src. Coverage.py pragma exclusions are omitted; the recorded API baseline reports 45 excluded lines.
exclusions.web: Unit coverage measures three pure presentation and navigation modules. Browser components and routes are exercised by the separate Playwright suite; their line coverage is not claimed here.
exclusions.worker: Test modules are excluded from the production code denominator. The API health test runs with the worker suite but is outside the worker code denominator.

limits: Local commands reproduce CI gate commands; GitHub Actions was not executed.
The isolated copy came from a dirty shared source snapshot; integration and CI results require a fresh run after applying the patch.
No browser E2E, provider, deployed service or production data was used.
